payload.summary: Reviewed the added habitat-registry regression suite against the underlying habitat/state/geometry implementation and did not find correctness, safety, or robustness issues in this change set. Targeted `cargo test -p tank_core --test habitat_registry` and `cargo test -p tank_core --test co2_exchange` both pass. The broader `cargo test -p tank_core` run still fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs::trim_plants_is_closed_system_via_helpers`, but that failure is outside the reviewed diff.
